NH has 32 delegates up for grabs:

  • 16 split proportionally based on popular vote of congressional districts

  • 8 split proportionally based on popular vote of entire state

  • 8 superdelegates (party officials) who vote however they want.

Bernie won the popular vote at about 60% which wins him 15 pledged delegates. Hillary lost the popular vote at about 40%, so she picks up the other 9 pledged delegates. That makes Bernie the winner.

This thread assumes the 8 superdelegates will all vote Hillary making it 15 to 17, but supers remain unpledged until the end. It's kind of early to consider them important.
